custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, whose tracking was turned off and back on, so its Part History has entries.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 2.4 and 5.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839485-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839485-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed with the clock icon at its left.

Step 2:

  • At the left a white card with rounded corners reads "Part details", then part A's description in blue (cut off with ".." when long), then the bold labels Part number, Category, Manufacturer and Measurement, each with its value under it.
  • To the right of the card sits the title "Part History", with a magnifier and the word "Search" at the top right of the page.
  • A table with the bold headers Staff, Date, Time and Event lists the entries, with a thin line between rows.
  • The entries "Tracking turned off" and "Tracking turned on" show in the Event column, in darker, slightly bolder text than Staff, Date and Time.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R20: “A Part History entry keeps the Staff, Date and Time columns of every other entry, and can be found with the Part History search.”
  • S10-R22: “Turning tracking off writes the entry "Tracking turned off" to the part's Part History, and turning it on writes "Tracking turned on". A part with nothing on hand still gets the entry.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "2.4 Part History at Heavy Duty", "5.5 Part History".
